name: Stonelair City
description: Stonelair City is located between the Malland Range’s foothills and the Crystal Torrent cascades. Towering stone walls protect the inhabitants, and within the city lie advanced structures, such as stone elevators and suspended tombs, which are not seen anywhere else. Smoke rises from countless forges, and the rhythmic clang of hammers echoes, capturing the city’s enduring spirit. The city has a grand entrance to Undertanares, where there is a constant flow of people and mining carts. The city is governed by the three Dwarven Kings—Rurik, Huradrin, and Ukhumlin—who extend opportunities for all to prosper, opening their rich mines for collective exploration. Known for its masonry, forging, trade, and jewel crafting, the city thrives on hard work, with its inhabitants taking only brief moments of rest. The city has another part inside the Undertanares with many distinguished features. The cleric class receives new subclasses in this section.
